explanation: This component fires only at D2 when the agent chose a2 but rarely ended up in S1: that step gets about 9-10 (10 more often earlier in the episode, about 9 later on), whatever the previous rewards were. Every other step is 0, including all D1 and GO steps and every D2 where a1 led to S1, a2 led to S2, or a1 rarely led to S2.
